name: cypress-mini-shop-assignment
description: Modular Cypress test suite demonstrating custom commands, fixtures, environment variables, cy.session(), cy.intercept(), flaky test fixes, parallel execution, and Mochawesome reporting.

scripts.report: npm run report:merge && npm run report:html
scripts.test:report: npm run test && npm run report
scripts.test:parallel: concurrently -k -s first "npm run test:auth" "npm run test:dashboard"
